name: spec-to-ship
description: A personal Codex workflow for taking implementation ideas from HTML spec through tests, implementation, review, simplification, and push.

interface.longDescription: A personal development workflow plugin built around /html-spec, /build-tests, and /simplify. It starts with an HTML spec, uses Codex annotations for review, creates tests before implementation, verifies red/green progress with goals, pauses for human QA, performs Codex code review, simplifies the result, then commits and pushes.
defaultPrompt: Use /html-spec to turn this idea into an HTML spec.
Use /build-tests to create tests from the approved spec.
Use /simplify after review to clean up the implementation.
